notes: Fixes the auto-updater restart loop. The swap script used `timeout`, which exits instantly when the app launches it detached, so it raced the still-running app, failed the swap, and relaunched the old build — forever. It now waits for the app to actually exit, verifies the new exe is in place before relaunching, restores the old one if anything goes wrong, and will only ever attempt one automatic install per version. If that attempt doesn't take, you get the banner and the reason instead of a loop.
